name: armasaur_guide_two_attackers_no_counter
notes: M4 mapper. Printed: 'Whenever you attack with three or more creatures, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.' Seat 0 attacks with Armasaur Guide and its Bear only (the Cub stays home): two attackers, no trigger, no counter anywhere. Seat 1 takes 4 + 2 = 6.
